limitations: The proof is elementary after Brahmagupta's substitution, so an equivalent inequality may exist in older geometric-inequality or symmetric-polynomial collections under different notation. The theorem is restricted to nondegenerate convex cyclic quadrilaterals; the zero value above the threshold is only an infimum.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and audit limitations are documented in RESULT.md and the independent-audit files.
record_title: Sharp lower area profile and reverse stability for cyclic quadrilaterals
